title: Tearing Into Tesla's Model 3
summary: Autoline's John McElroy visits Sandy Munro's shop, where a Tesla Model 3 is being prepared for a teardown benchmarking study. Munro, with deep design and manufacturing experience, points out issues he dislikes about the car's build.
why: Cited as an early expert critique of Model 3 fit, finish and manufacturing quality, and for its note on hard-to-find emergency door releases.

quote.text: reported really poor fit and finish quality - rattling doors, poorly fitted gaps around the trunk
